articles.title: Kenya to South Africa
articles.teaser: A trip down the continent, and a slightly unusual walking tour of Johannesburg.
paragraphs: I backpacked from Kenya to South Africa, travelling through Tanzania, Malawi and Zimbabwe along the way. Malawi was one of my favourite stops.

Before I got to South Africa, people I met further north kept warning me about it. In Johannesburg, I asked a friend whether he knew someone who could take me around the city centre. He found me a man about six foot five. I paid him about $100 to walk around with me for a few hours.
There are a few photographs from my travels in the album, including some shoe shopping in Nairobi.

articles.title: Why this website looks like this
articles.teaser: I liked Braintree Town's website so much that I wanted one like it.
paragraphs: I posted about Braintree Town FC's website recently. It felt like visiting an old person's house with all of their vintage knick-knacks. I loved it. I hope they leave it alone.
I wanted this website to have that same feeling. Something very 1998, with photos, links and things to read.

You might know me from Timcast. I'm putting some of that work here, but I also want to write more about culture, travel and what's going on elsewhere in the world. There are already a few photos from Africa to have a look at. I'm working on a newsletter about Africa too.
Anyway, welcome. Have a look around.
